scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:rust
scripts.icons: rsvg-convert -w 1024 -h 1024 assets/app-icon.svg -o /tmp/mad-icon-1024.png && tauri icon /tmp/mad-icon-1024.png && rm -rf src-tauri/icons/android src-tauri/icons/ios src-tauri/icons/Square*.png src-tauri/icons/StoreLogo.png src-tauri/icons/icon.ico
